## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature (new API / sample / layer)
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Test plan

- [ ] EditMode tests pass locally (`Window → General → Test Runner → EditMode → Run All`)
- [ ] PlayMode tests pass locally (or covered by CI)
- [ ] If a sample was added/renamed: `HomeSceneLoader._samples` and `Samples/README.md` are updated
- [ ] If a public API changed: XML doc-comment is updated and CHANGELOG `## [Unreleased]` has an entry
- [ ] Manual verification — open the affected sample and confirm the change
      visually / via the Console (UI changes can't be verified by tests alone)
